Elias read it twice by lamplight, then once more. For thirty years he had kept the light alone, answering no letters, receiving none. Somewhere, he reasoned, a patient child deserved an answer.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市沉在最深的静里。街灯把湿漉漉的路面照成一条条金色的河，偶尔有出租车碾过积水，声音被夜色吸走大半。便利店的灯还亮着，像一枚不肯熄灭的琥珀。写字楼顶层剩一两扇窗有光，那是还没回家的人。环卫工人推着车缓缓走过，扫帚划地，沙沙作响。远处的高架桥上，一辆货车亮着灯，孤独地驶向黎明。城市睡着了，可总有人醒着，守着它的呼吸。", "w03": "• Recursion is when you solve a big problem by first solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n• Think of Russian nesting dolls: to open the biggest one, you keep opening smaller ones until you reach a tiny doll that doesn't open at all — that's the stopping point.\n• The stopping point matters, because without it you'd keep opening dolls forever and never finish."}
